firstAttempt.result: 70 of 87 passed. The 17 browser suites could not load Playwright, because AIW_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE was not set as it was for v20.2. This was a setup error in the run, not a product failure; the run above repeats it with the v20.2 settings.

checkNames: every held-out case builds its packet from a real reference design and runs the full reasoning path
the teaching-domain capacity drafts expose advice that takes the Playbook example objective at face value
injected faults are caught: guards withhold invented numbers, guarantees, missing citations and out-of-bounds refinements
the metrics catch what the guards let through: a wrong verdict and advice missing its expected support
false-support proxy: numbers not in the cited sources and overclaiming words are flagged
the scorer reads numbers as the guard does: a citation label is not a number, and every flag keeps its sentence
a negated or hedged guarantee passes, as in the guard; an asserted one is flagged with its sentence
the control arm asks the same model the same questions without the Brain’s packet, instructions or format of citations
the Brain’s checks run on the control arm’s answers to measure what it would withhold, and the comparison pairs every assessment
each withheld assessment is labelled by the check that raised its issue, not by the words in it
a kept report scores again to the same result without asking any model, and only while the design reads as it did
only the evaluation reaches the control arm: the application reasons through requestReasoning alone
adoption rates come from what architects did with advice in a real project, not from this harness

keyHandling: The sponsor supplied an env file for the purpose. For each run it was extracted to the session's temporary folder, loaded into the evaluation process with node --env-file, never displayed, and deleted after the run started or ended. The supplied zip is unchanged. The model was pinned for the runs with AIW_LLM_MODEL=gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 and the endpoint left at the OpenAI default.
